# Biotite - multitool for bioinformatics

![Biotite logo](/images/biotite_logo.svg)

Biotite is a python library designed specifically for common tasks in bioinformatics, including: 
  
- Homology and alignment 
- Building sequence profiles 
- Annotating features on sequences 
- Identification of open reading frames
- Protein structure visualisation 

This package bundles popular tasks in computational molecular biology into a uniform and fast Python library.

Find out more [on the biotite webpage](https://www.biotite-python.org/latest/index.html)
